name: Lanoree Brock's Peacemaker
description: Lanoree Brock's Peacemaker was the personal Peacemaker-class cruiser of Je'daii Ranger Lanoree Brock during the Stargazer Uprising. Ironholgs, an upgraded Holgorian IM-220 maintenance droid, was assigned to security and maintenance of the ship, and was capable of remotely piloting it.
